title: California rehabilitation alumni stories
type: Public stories · not a cohort dataset
detail: Official adult alumni stories describe training and published post-release employment milestones. Useful as source material illustrating what a dated, documented milestone looks like.
limitations: Stories are selectively published, not a representative release cohort. No alumni identities are imported into this app. Do not calculate recidivism or infer program causation from these stories. Publication does not authorize unrelated personal research.

title: California juvenile recidivism reports
publication: FY 2013–14 and FY 2014–15 release cohorts listed
detail: Separate youth reports measure three-year arrest, conviction, and return to state custody, including juvenile or adult state institutions.
limitations: Historical youth cohorts are separate from the adult-prison TPW brief. These reports do not provide a named youth roster or current participant follow-up. No juvenile participant identities are collected in this app.

title: California Juvenile Detention Profile Survey
publisher: Board of State and Community Corrections
detail: Queryable state/county facility population data and trends. Useful for describing juvenile facility scale and demand; raw data can be accessed through the linked official query tool.
limitations: Facility populations are not participant outcomes or three-year recidivism. Collection varies by agency, some dashboard values are imputed, and revisions can change historical figures. Not a source of named participant identities.
